title: Past experimental interbreeding between aliens and humans
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Past experimental interbreeding between aliens and humans, about past (communicated early 1990s) at Earth, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> I got the impression that they had interbreeded before um experimentally.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former US Air Force sergeant, says that in the early 1990s the NSA, the US agency that intercepts communications, hired him to communicate with aliens. He says that through this contact he got the impression that they had interbred with humans in the past, as an experiment. If true, it would mean aliens had a hand in human ancestry.
